fidelity: F2a — Monod Growth with Ethanol Product Inhibition + Lumped Thermal ODE
source: Bai, Anderson & Moo-Young (2008) Biotechnol. Adv. 26:89-105; Luong (1985) Biotechnol. Bioeng. 27:280-285; Levenspiel (1980) Biotechnol. Bioeng. 22:1671; Monod (1949) Annu. Rev. Microbiol. 3:371

unit.name: Generic S. cerevisiae Batch/Fed-Batch Bioethanol Fermenter — Physics-Lumped Kinetics + Thermal

mu_max.note: Max specific growth rate, S. cerevisiae on glucose, ~30-32 C (Bai 2008)

Ks.note: Monod half-saturation constant for glucose (Bai 2008 range 0.5-2)

Yxs.note: Apparent biomass yield on the anabolic glucose fraction; most carbon is catabolised to ethanol so only a small glucose share builds biomass (Bai 2008)

Yps.note: Observed ethanol yield on glucose; <= theoretical 0.511 (Bai 2008)

Yps_theoretical.note: Gay-Lussac stoichiometric max: C6H12O6 -> 2 C2H5OH + 2 CO2

beta_lp.note: Luedeking-Piret non-growth ethanol coefficient (dominant fermentative flux)

P_star.note: Critical ethanol conc. for fermentation/product formation (Luong 1985; ~90-100 g/L)

P_star_growth.note: Critical ethanol conc. for growth; lower than P* (yeast growth is more ethanol-sensitive than fermentation, Bai 2008)

n_luong.note: Luong inhibition exponent for growth (n>1 toxic power-law, Luong 1985)

n_luong_p.note: Luong inhibition exponent for product formation

S0.note: Initial glucose concentration (very high gravity fermentation)

dH_ferment.note: Exothermic heat of fermentation, ~0.553 MJ/kg glucose (Bai 2008)

UA_cool.note: Cooling jacket overall heat-transfer coefficient * area (1 m3 reactor)
